children: RNS Number : 3269W  Lloyds Banking Group PLC  25 September 2026

Following the purchase of ordinary shares on 24 September 2026, Lloyds Banking Group plc (the "Company") announces that the Company's share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026 was completed in accordance with its terms. The programme was managed by Goldman Sachs International. In aggregate between 30 January 2026 and 24 September 2026, the Company repurchased 1,712,662,647 ordinary shares for an aggregate consideration of £1.75bn.
